preconditions.description: The input n must be an integer.
The input n must be less than or equal to 100.
The input n must be non-negative.

postconditions.description: If n is 0 or negative, the output must be an empty string.
The output must contain exactly (2n-1) lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == len(stdout.splitlines()[n-1]) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: All lines in the output must have the same length as the longest line.
